editorial.description_en: A river surface at first light, holding the sky rather than its own colour.
editorial.description_ja: 朝いちばんの川面のような、明るい青。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.858, C 0.044, h 238.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 朝 (asa, morning) + 川 (kawa, river). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Morning River" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 朝川. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — usu-mizu at ΔE00 4.7, ame-zora at ΔE00 4.9, to-yama at ΔE00 5.9. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (58°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
